basic_details.job_title: Jharkhand Home Guard Vacancy 2026 - Apply Online for 457 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Jharkhand Home Guard Vacancy 2026: Jharkhand Home Defence Corps, Latehar, has issued for 457 Rural and Urban Home Guard posts, including 446 Rural Home Guard and 11 Urban Home Guard positions. Candidates who have passed 7th standard for Rural Home Guard or 10th standard for Urban Home Guard and meet the prescribed residence and physical requirements can apply online. The age limit is 19 to 40 years as on 1 January 2026. Online applications will be accepted from 17 November to 1 December 2026 through recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in. The application fee is Rs. 100.

how_to_apply: Visit the official website at recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in.
Locate the Home Guard Advertisement No. 01/2026 for Latehar district.
Read the notification and verify the education, age, residence and physical eligibility conditions.
Open the online application facility during the advertised period.
Enter personal information, date of birth, contact details and address.
Select the eligible Rural or Urban Home Guard category.
Select the block or urban area for which the residence condition is satisfied.
Enter educational qualifications and applicable technical skills or experience.
Upload the prescribed self-attested supporting certificates.
Upload a recent passport-size colour photograph and signature.
Enter the accepted identity document details as requested.
Pay the Rs. 100 application fee through the online payment gateway.
Submit the completed application by 1 December 2026.
Save the application acknowledgement and fee payment details for future reference.
Important: Only one application per candidate is permitted. Multiple applications from different blocks or urban areas may result in cancellation of candidature.

content_sections.heading: Jharkhand Home Guard Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the educational qualification, local residence, age and physical standards applicable to Rural or Urban Home Guard positions. Rural Home Guard applicants must be permanent residents of the block for which they apply. Urban Home Guard candidates must be ordinary residents of the notified urban area. All applicants must submit the required residential certificate issued by the competent authority. Applicants must provide the relevant technical qualification or experience certificate to support their eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Jharkhand Home Guard Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The prescribed age limit is 19 to 40 years as on 1 January 2026 for Rural and Urban Home Guard applicants.

content_sections.heading: Jharkhand Home Guard Physical Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the minimum height and chest requirements specified for the relevant categories. SC/ST candidates claiming the prescribed relaxation must provide a valid caste certificate. Chest measurements apply to male candidates.

content_sections.heading: Jharkhand Home Guard Salary and Duty Allowance 2026
content_sections.text: Home Guard members are volunteers and do not hold regular Government employee status. Selected candidates receive a duty allowance at Government-prescribed rates when deployed. Re-enrolment after the initial four-year period is governed by the applicable Jharkhand Home Guard rules.

content_sections.heading: Jharkhand Home Guard Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 100 for all applicants , payable through the online payment gateway. The online application will be accepted only after successful fee payment. Candidates should retain the payment confirmation.

content_sections.heading: Jharkhand Home Guard Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection procedure includes physical measurement, Physical Efficiency Test, Hindi Writing Ability Test and a Technical Skill Test for Urban Technical Home Guard applicants. Application scrutiny and eligibility verification. Physical Measurement Test. Physical Efficiency Test, including running, high jump, long jump and shot put. Hindi Writing Ability Test. Technical Skill Test for applicable Urban Technical candidates. Merit list preparation according to the notified assessment rules. Document verification and prescribed training before enrolment.

content_sections.heading: Jharkhand Home Guard Physical Test 2026
content_sections.text: The physical test requirements differ between Rural/Urban Non-Technical and Urban Technical Home Guard applicants. Candidates exceeding six minutes for men or ten minutes for women in the one-mile run will be considered ineligible under the prescribed running standard. The notification provides additional performance-based marks for higher achievements in jumping and shot put events.

content_sections.heading: Jharkhand Home Guard Hindi Writing Test 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates qualifying in the physical assessment must appear for a Hindi Writing Ability Test, which is qualifying in nature.

content_sections.heading: Jharkhand Home Guard Technical Skill Test 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible Urban Technical Home Guard candidates who qualify in the physical and Hindi writing tests will undergo a practical technical skill assessment.

content_sections.heading: Jharkhand Home Guard Bonus Marks 2026
content_sections.text: The notification provides additional marks for eligible candidates who have obtained recognized national or state-level sports achievements. The notification provides special consideration for eligible Government employees against up to 10% of the notified Urban Home Guard positions. content_sections.text: Candidates can apply for Jharkhand Home Guard Vacancy 2026 through the official Jharkhand Government recruitment portal. Applications are scheduled to open on 17 November 2026 and close on 1 December 2026 . Apply Online: Jharkhand Home Guard Official Recruitment Portal Application Fee: Rs. 100. content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Jharkhand Home Guard Vacancy 2026?
content_sections.text: Important: Only one application per candidate is permitted. Multiple applications from different blocks or urban areas may result in cancellation of candidature.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Jharkhand Home Guard Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must upload self-attested documents supporting their eligibility and applicable reservation or bonus marks. Residential certificate issued by the competent authority. 7th Pass certificate for Rural Home Guard. 10th Pass certificate for Urban Home Guard. Valid date-of-birth certificate. Caste certificate, if applicable. Technical qualification or experience certificate for Urban Technical Home Guard. Employment certificate for eligible serving Government employees. Sports achievement certificate, if claiming bonus marks. Certificate for eligible divorced, abandoned or widowed women, where applicable. Recent passport-size colour photograph. Candidate signature. Accepted identity document details, as required by the portal.
